target.query:
SELECT toUInt64(event_time) * 1000 AS time, concat('Restart: ', host) AS text, 'restart' AS tags
FROM (SELECT hostName() AS host, event_time, value,
             lagInFrame(value, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY hostName() ORDER BY event_time) AS prev
      FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.asynchronous_metric_log)
      WHERE metric = 'Uptime' AND hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter)
WHERE prev > value
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

SELECT toUInt64(event_time) * 1000 AS time, concat('Lease lost: ', hostName()) AS text, 'lease' AS tags
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.metric_log)
WHERE ProfileEvent_CASMountLeaseLost > 0 AND hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

description: Health of content-addressed (CAS) storage for people who run the cluster: is storage online, are writes safe, is garbage collection keeping up, is anything wrong. Details for support engineers are on CAS / Drilldown.

panels.description: Every host can read and write the shared storage right now. Hosts not reporting: hosts in the cluster that did not answer. Disks not live: storage disks that lost their connection to the pool. Lease lost: how many times a host lost its write permission in the selected period. Metrics age: seconds since the last metrics row; when the storage is down the server stops writing its own logs, so a growing age is itself a warning. What to do: check the host and its object storage endpoint; see Drilldown → Writes: lease and Writes: mounts now.

targets.query:
SELECT
    (SELECT count() FROM system.clusters WHERE cluster = '$cluster') - uniqExact(host) AS "Hosts not reporting",
    countIf(lifecycle != 'live') AS "Disks not live"
FROM (SELECT hostName() AS host, disk, any(lifecycle) AS lifecycle
      FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.cas_mounts)
      WHERE disk IN ($disk)
      GROUP BY host, disk)
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

SELECT if(count() = 0, NULL, sum(ProfileEvent_CASMountLeaseLost)) AS "Lease lost",
    dateDiff('second', max(event_time), now()) AS "Metrics age (s)"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.metric_log)
WHERE hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Storage online

panels.description: Writes to the shared storage are confirmed. Gave up: writes abandoned after all retries (any value needs a look). Unresolved %: share of writes whose answer from the storage was lost and had to be re-checked by reading back; 0.03% is normal on a healthy backend, a rise means storage timeouts. What to do: check object-storage latency and errors; see Drilldown → Writes: conditional writes and S3: errors and throttling.

targets.query:
SELECT if(count() = 0, NULL, sum(ProfileEvent_CASRequestGaveUp)) AS "Gave up",
    if(sum(ProfileEvent_CASConditionalWriteAttempts) = 0, NULL,
       round(100 * sum(ProfileEvent_CASConditionalWriteUnresolved) / sum(ProfileEvent_CASConditionalWriteAttempts), 3)) AS "Unresolved %"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.metric_log)
WHERE hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Writes safe

panels.description: Garbage collection frees storage that deleted or merged data no longer needs. Rounds normally finish every 5–10 minutes. Minutes since last success: time since the last completed round anywhere in the cluster; yellow after 30 minutes, red after 2 hours. Failed rounds: rounds in the selected period that ended with an error or were aborted (an event count: no rows means none). What to do: open Drilldown → GC: rounds for the error text; a long-running round is normal after a large deletion, a stopped one is not.

targets.query:
SELECT if(count() = 0, NULL, dateDiff('minute', max(event_time), now())) AS "Minutes since last success" /* now */
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.cas_gc_log)
WHERE disk_name IN ($disk) AND event_type = 'Finish' AND outcome IN ('Success', 'Deferred') AND event_date >= today() - 7
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

SELECT countIf(outcome IN ('Error', 'Aborted', 'Stopped')) AS "Failed rounds"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.cas_gc_log)
WHERE disk_name IN ($disk) AND event_type = 'Finish' AND $timeFilter
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: GC: last success

panels.description: Is garbage collection keeping up with deletions? Each round marks objects for deletion and deletes objects marked earlier. Backlog growth: over the last 10 rounds, the share of newly marked objects that were not yet deleted; near zero is steady state, it rises for about an hour after a server restart and recovers by itself. Yellow above 25%, red above 50%. Net objects: marked minus deleted over those rounds. What to do: if red for more than two hours, open Drilldown → GC: stage flow and GC: round cost.

targets.query:
SELECT if(count() = 0, NULL, round(100 * sum(net) / greatest(sum(cond), 1), 1)) AS "Backlog growth %, last 10 rounds",
       if(count() = 0, NULL, sum(net)) AS "Net objects, last 10 rounds" /* now */
FROM (SELECT toInt64(entries_condemned) - toInt64(entries_redeleted) AS net, toInt64(entries_condemned) AS cond
      FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.cas_gc_log)
      WHERE disk_name IN ($disk) AND event_type = 'Finish' AND outcome = 'Success' AND event_date >= today() - 7
      ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 10)
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Garbage trend

panels.description: Signals that must stay at zero. Integrity events: the storage found data that should exist but does not, or could not be decoded (an event log: no rows means no events, so this field cannot show 'no data'; the Storage online tile's Metrics age tells whether logging itself stopped). GC anomalies: garbage collection hit an inconsistency and worked around it; a value that stays above zero across rounds deserves a look. Wedged lanes and Lanes needing recovery: a table's write queue to the shared storage is stuck. What to do: any red value is a support case; keep the selected time range and open Drilldown → Needs attention and GC: anomalies.

targets.query:
SELECT count() AS "Integrity events"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.cas_log)
WHERE disk_name IN ($disk) AND event_type IN ('read_missing', 'dangling_access', 'corrupt_dangle', 'corrupt_decode', 'snap_journal_incoherent', 'exception') AND $timeFilter
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

SELECT if(count() = 0, NULL, sum(anomalies)) AS "GC anomalies"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.cas_gc_log)
WHERE disk_name IN ($disk) AND event_type = 'Finish' AND $timeFilter
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

SELECT if(count() = 0, NULL, sum(ProfileEvent_CASRefNeedsRecovery)) AS "Lanes needing recovery"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.metric_log)
WHERE hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

SELECT if(count() = 0, NULL, max(v)) AS "Wedged lanes"
FROM (SELECT hostName() AS host, argMax(value, event_time) AS v
      FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.asynchronous_metric_log)
      WHERE hostName() IN ($host) AND metric LIKE 'CASGCWedgedNamespaces_%'
        AND replaceOne(metric, 'CASGCWedgedNamespaces_', '') IN ($disk) AND $timeFilter
      GROUP BY host)
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Integrity

panels.description: The object storage is answering at full speed. Throttling per minute: requests the storage slowed down (HTTP 429/503) per minute over the selected period; zero is normal, bursts follow a server restart. S3 errors: failed uploads or deletes per hour, not counting the storage's expected answers to concurrent writes of the same object (HTTP 412 and 409); a few per day are normal and retried, yellow above 5 per hour, red above 50. What to do: sustained throttling means the request rate is above the bucket's limit; see Drilldown → S3: by verb and S3: errors and throttling.

targets.query:
SELECT if(count() = 0, NULL,
       round(60 * (sum(ProfileEvent_S3ReadRequestsThrottling) + sum(ProfileEvent_S3WriteRequestsThrottling))
             / greatest(dateDiff('second', min(event_time), max(event_time)), 1), 2)) AS "Throttling per minute"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.metric_log)
WHERE hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

SELECT round(countIf(error != '' AND error NOT LIKE '%PreconditionFailed%' AND error NOT LIKE '%ConditionalRequestConflict%')
             / greatest(($__to - $__from) / 3600000, 1), 1) AS "S3 errors per hour"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.blob_storage_log)
WHERE disk_name IN ($disk) AND $timeFilter
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: S3 throttling

panels.description: Recent events that need a person: integrity findings, garbage-collection rounds that failed or were aborted, failed storage-lease renewals or reconnects, and hosts fenced out of the pool. Empty is good. What to do: read the Details column; the same events appear with full context on the Drilldown.

targets.query:
SELECT toUInt64(event_time) * 1000 AS "Time", host AS "Host", what AS "What happened", detail AS "Details"
FROM (
    SELECT event_time, hostName() AS host, concat('Integrity: ', toString(event_type)) AS what,
           concat(namespace, ' ', ref_name, ' ', toString(reason)) AS detail
    FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.cas_log)
    WHERE disk_name IN ($disk) AND event_type IN ('read_missing', 'dangling_access', 'corrupt_dangle', 'corrupt_decode', 'snap_journal_incoherent', 'exception') AND $timeFilter
    UNION ALL
    SELECT event_time, hostName() AS host, concat('GC round ', toString(round), ': ', toString(outcome)) AS what, error AS detail
    FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.cas_gc_log)
    WHERE disk_name IN ($disk) AND event_type = 'Finish' AND outcome IN ('Error', 'Aborted', 'Stopped') AND $timeFilter
    UNION ALL
    SELECT event_time, hostName() AS host, concat('Storage lease: ', toString(event_type), ' ', toString(outcome)) AS what,
           concat(toString(reason), ' ', toString(detail)) AS detail
    FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.cas_log)
    WHERE disk_name IN ($disk) AND event_type IN ('mount_remount', 'watermark_renew') AND outcome = 'failed' AND $timeFilter
    UNION ALL
    SELECT event_time, hostName() AS host, 'GC fenced out an expired host' AS what, concat(toString(reason), ' ', toString(detail)) AS detail
    FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.cas_log)
    WHERE disk_name IN ($disk) AND event_type = 'gc_fence_out' AND $timeFilter
)
ORDER BY "Time" DESC LIMIT 100
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Needs attention

panels.description: Each host renews its write permission every 10 s. Retries and recoveries mean the storage answered slowly; Lost means a host was cut off and had to reconnect.

targets.query:
SELECT $timeSeries AS t, sum(ProfileEvent_CASMountRenewalAttempts) / $interval AS "Attempts", sum(ProfileEvent_CASMountRenewalRetries) / $interval AS "Retries", sum(ProfileEvent_CASMountRenewalRecovered) / $interval AS "Recovered", sum(ProfileEvent_CASMountLeaseLost) / $interval AS "Lost"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.metric_log)
WHERE hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Storage lease renewals per second

panels.description: Committed: writes the storage confirmed. Unresolved: writes whose confirmation was lost and had to be re-checked by reading back; normally a tiny fraction of committed.

targets.query:
SELECT $timeSeries AS t, sum(ProfileEvent_CASConditionalWriteCommitted) / $interval AS "Committed", sum(ProfileEvent_CASConditionalWriteUnresolved) / $interval AS "Unresolved"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.metric_log)
WHERE hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Writes: committed vs unresolved per second

panels.description: Average time an INSERT, merge or delete waited for the shared storage's write queue. About 200 ms is normal on otel.demo; a sustained rise slows every INSERT.

targets.query:
SELECT $timeSeries AS t, sum(ProfileEvent_CASRefQueueWaitMicroseconds) / greatest(sum(ProfileEvent_CASRefBatchedMutations), 1) / 1000 AS "Wait per operation"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.metric_log)
WHERE hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Insert delay caused by storage (ms per operation)

panels.description: How many garbage-collection rounds finished, colored by outcome. Success and Deferred are healthy (Deferred = nothing to do). Error, Aborted or Stopped bars need a look at Needs attention.

targets.query:
SELECT $timeSeries AS t, toString(outcome) AS outcome, count()
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.cas_gc_log)
WHERE disk_name IN ($disk) AND hostName() IN ($host) AND event_type = 'Finish' AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY t, outcome ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: GC rounds per 30 minutes, by outcome

panels.description: Wall-clock time of each finished round. Rounds take a few minutes on otel.demo; a long round after a large deletion is normal, a round that never finishes is not.

targets.query:
SELECT toUInt64(event_time) * 1000 AS t, toString(outcome) AS outcome, duration_ms
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.cas_gc_log)
WHERE disk_name IN ($disk) AND hostName() IN ($host) AND event_type = 'Finish' AND $timeFilter
ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: GC round duration

panels.description: Marked: objects a round found to be garbage. Deleted: objects it physically removed. Over time the two lines should track each other; deleted staying below marked for many rounds means the backlog grows.

targets.query:
SELECT toUInt64(event_time) * 1000 AS t, entries_condemned AS "Marked", entries_redeleted AS "Deleted"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.cas_gc_log)
WHERE disk_name IN ($disk) AND hostName() IN ($host) AND event_type = 'Finish' AND outcome = 'Success' AND $timeFilter
ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: GC per round: marked vs deleted objects

panels.description: Running total of marked minus deleted objects since the start of the selected period. Flat or falling is healthy; a line that keeps rising means garbage is being found faster than it is removed.

targets.query:
SELECT t, sum(net) OVER (ORDER BY t) AS "Net backlog change"
FROM (SELECT toUInt64(event_time) * 1000 AS t, toInt64(entries_condemned) - toInt64(entries_redeleted) AS net
      FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.cas_gc_log)
      WHERE disk_name IN ($disk) AND hostName() IN ($host) AND event_type = 'Finish' AND outcome = 'Success' AND $timeFilter)
ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: GC backlog change over the selected period

panels.description: What the shared storage holds right now, as counted by the last garbage-collection round. Tables: tables with data in the storage. Write-log entries: records of inserts and deletes not yet compacted away. The total counts of data objects, parts and part descriptions are not available yet.

targets.query:
SELECT if(countIf(mapContains(phase_metrics, 'namespaces_seen')) = 0, NULL, argMaxIf(phase_metrics['namespaces_seen'], event_time, mapContains(phase_metrics, 'namespaces_seen'))) AS "Tables", if(countIf(mapContains(phase_metrics, 'ref_log_keys_listed')) = 0, NULL, argMaxIf(phase_metrics['ref_log_keys_listed'], event_time, mapContains(phase_metrics, 'ref_log_keys_listed'))) AS "Write-log entries" /* now */
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.cas_gc_log)
WHERE disk_name IN ($disk) AND hostName() IN ($host) AND event_type = 'Phase' AND event_date >= today() - 7
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Tables and write logs

panels.description: Data objects are the pieces of table data in the shared storage. New: objects uploaded; Deleted: objects removed by garbage collection. Over days the two should balance; deleted staying at zero while new grows means garbage collection is not removing anything.

targets.query:
SELECT $timeSeries AS t, sum(ProfileEvent_CASBlobHeadMiss) / $interval AS "New", sum(ProfileEvent_CASBlobDelete) / $interval AS "Deleted"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.metric_log)
WHERE hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Data objects: new vs deleted per second

panels.description: Every data part has one description object in the shared storage. New ones appear on insert and merge, deleted ones follow part removal.

targets.query:
SELECT $timeSeries AS t, sum(ProfileEvent_CASManifestPut) / $interval AS "New", sum(ProfileEvent_CASManifestDelete) / $interval AS "Deleted"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.metric_log)
WHERE hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Part descriptions: new vs deleted per second

panels.description: Each insert or delete appends an entry to the table's write log in the shared storage; garbage collection compacts old entries away. Written staying above cleaned for a long time means the logs keep growing.

targets.query:
SELECT $timeSeries AS t, sum(ProfileEvent_CASRootPut) / $interval AS "Written", sum(ProfileEvent_CASRootDelete) / $interval AS "Cleaned"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.metric_log)
WHERE hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Write-log entries: written vs cleaned per second

panels.description: Bytes written to the shared storage: table data, part descriptions, write logs and GC state. This is traffic, not the amount stored; stored totals are not available yet.

targets.query:
SELECT $timeSeries AS t, multiIf(p2 = 'blobs', 'Table data', p2 = 'cas' AND p3 = 'manifests', 'Part descriptions',
                                     p2 = 'cas' AND p3 = 'ns', 'Write logs', p2 = 'gc', 'GC state', 'Other') AS kind, sum(data_size) / $interval
FROM (SELECT event_time, event_date, data_size, splitByChar('/', remote_path)[2] AS p2, splitByChar('/', remote_path)[3] AS p3
      FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.blob_storage_log)
      WHERE disk_name IN ($disk) AND hostName() IN ($host) AND event_type IN ('Upload', 'MultiPartUploadWrite') AND $timeFilter)
GROUP BY t, kind ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Data uploaded per second, by kind

panels.description: All requests the cluster sends to the object storage. Cost drivers are PUT and LIST; GET and HEAD are cheap. Spikes of LIST follow a server restart.

targets.query:
SELECT $timeSeries AS t, sum(ProfileEvent_S3PutObject) / $interval AS "PUT", sum(ProfileEvent_S3GetObject) / $interval AS "GET", sum(ProfileEvent_S3HeadObject) / $interval AS "HEAD", sum(ProfileEvent_S3ListObjects) / $interval AS "LIST", sum(ProfileEvent_S3DeleteObjects) / $interval AS "DELETE"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.metric_log)
WHERE hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: S3 requests per second, by type

panels.description: Requests the object storage slowed down (HTTP 429/503). Zero is normal; bursts follow a restart; a steady rate means the request rate is above the bucket's limit.

targets.query:
SELECT $timeSeries AS t, sum(ProfileEvent_S3ReadRequestsThrottling) / $interval AS "Read throttling", sum(ProfileEvent_S3WriteRequestsThrottling) / $interval AS "Write throttling"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.metric_log)
WHERE hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1
